column2: Something about the earth's flow here seems to have a healing effect.
It's true! My body feels lighter somehow...
HP restored!
HP restored!
Hm? This looks like a different kind of switch from the last one...
Are you gonna press it, Ban-chan?
What else would I do?!
Th-that scared me...
...A hole opened up somewhere else.
Okay, let's press it one more time...
S-stop it, Ban-chan!! That's dangerous!!
It's your fault for scurrying around all over the place!
Heh...
In any case, now we understand how the switches work.
Ban-chan, another different switch! What do we do?
...Well, guess we gotta press it.
There was a sound somewhere far off...
Huh? The button sank all the way in.
It seems it's built so it can only be pressed once.
This is a different switch too... Ban-chan, what do we do?
We press it, obviously.
There was a sound in the distance...
Photo for memory of trip, yes?
Photographer-san, all the way out here... That must be rough.
No worry. Is okay, is okay.
Huh? This one's all math.
...Maybe it means press the switches with the answers' numbers, in order?
Lemon -> Spinach -> Strawberry -> Tangerine
A s-secret code!! Could it be a message from aliens?!
But isn't it a little too simple to call a code?
...Indeed.
Huh, is it?
Riddles
Q1 What color is the Isle of Wight?
Q2 What color is the house where the President lives?
R... riddles???
Hmm, the Isle of Wight... green, maybe?
The President's house... I've never been there, so I dunno...
Ginji-kun... That would not make it a riddle.
S-sorry...
These... both appear to be the same color.
Y-you know the answer, Akabane-san?!
Please, at least give me a hint!
...Ginji-kun, how is "Wight" pronounced? And what is the President's house called?
I-I think I know...
Then you should know what color they both are...
What the hell is this?
Doesn't it mean we're supposed to do something in this order?
Do something?
We'd better search the area...
Wh-what's this? I don't get it.
It seems we're meant to do something in this order...
It seems we must search the area...
This is bad, Akabane-san! It's a secret code!!
It is fine. A code is always made to be solved, after all.
There must be a hint somewhere. Let us look for it.
There's a yellow switch...
There's a red switch...
There's a blue switch...
There's a green switch...
There's a white switch...
There's a silver switch...
There's a purple switch...
There's an orange switch...
Looks like I screwed up... Let's try that again.
It seems I made a mistake... Let's try again.
Aww, looks like I messed up... Let's try again.
Alright! Let's charge on ahead!!
No. We might undo another team's door switch if we go on...
Fine, fine... Guess we'll wait.
Oooh, we finally made it through! Then let's head on!
No, we mustn't.
We might end up undoing another team's door switch...
It seems best to wait here...
Yaaay, we made it through, we made it~!!
Akabane-san, let's keep going on ahead!
I do not mind... but the others might not be able to get out.
Is that really alright with you?
Oh... L-let's wait here after all...
Guess we'd better wait around here for the others...
Shall we wait here for the others...?
Let's wait here for Ban-chan and the others!
...Hey, Ginji. Just 'cause Al's gone,
quit moping around forever. We're better off without that jinx.
But... Al-kun's so spacey,
he might've gotten caught by some shady street salesman somewhere!
Even if he did, he ain't got any money worth taking.
And he's got a terrible sense of direction, just like me,
so he might've gotten lost somewhere and collapsed!!
Yeah... that might be bad...
Right?! I'm so worried I can't get anything down my throat~...
You just ate three servings of pizza!!
But still~...
(...Ginji-san's really down in the dumps.)
(Well, Al up and vanished on him. Can't be helped.)
(But with Gin-chan like this, I don't think I can give them any jobs for a while...)
Hello. It's been a while.
Yaaay, it's Clayman-san~! Long time no see!!
(...Talk about a quick change of heart.)
What do you want, Clayman?
I'd like to hire you two for a job...
I'd like you to retrieve a legendary treasure that was stolen.
...A legendary treasure?
Yes... The treasure of the 'Lost Continent,' which sank into the sea in a single night.
What's that, Atlantis or something?
Stuff like that's gotta be a myth, right?
You can't be so sure about that.
The DVD-ROM you two retrieved the other day holds a paper about that continent.
Yes... The 'Lost Continent' is gradually being proven to exist by science.
But two universities are waging an ugly dispute over its existence.
So one's sabotaging the other? Saving face ain't easy for colleges, huh.
Passed from hand to hand, it will soon go up at a secret auction.
I'd like you two to take the treasure back at that opportunity.
...I'm just not feeling it. It's gotta be a fake anyway.
H-hey, Ban-chan!
Clayman-san, where's the auction being held?
On Niihama Island.
What?! You mean that island, already famous as a pick-up spot,
that's now a huge hit with girls since hot springs sprang up there? Niihama Island?!
Yes... So, what do you say? Will you take the job?
Of course!
GetBackers! This job... consider it done!!
Wait for me, bikini babes! Bwahahaha!
B-Ban-chan, you changed your mind way too fast~...
(...They're both as bad as each other, aren't they?)
(Yeah... They sure are...)
Ban-chan... I've been thinking this since we were on the boat, but...
...isn't it cold?
If it's this cold, there's no way anyone's going swimming in the sea...
The blazing sun... my bikini babes.........
It's spring! Of course there aren't any bikini babes.
...We still have some time before the auction, don't we?
Would it be alright if Juubei and I went off on our own?
Huh, where are you going?
There's a hot spring said to be good for the eyes. I thought we'd try it.
Oh, that sounds like a good idea! See you later!
...That's right, there's still the yukata babes!
Alright, we're hitting the hot springs too! Let's go, Ginji!!
Ban-chaaan, wait for meee!!
Can't keep quiet when I hear "babes"! Let's go too, Shido-han!!
I've got no interest in some hot spring.
Oh, come on! You wanna peek too, Shido-han!!
Alrighty, let's get goin'~!
...What is with those guys?
We're here on a job, and they're not taking it seriously at all.
There is still time before the operation begins.
It cannot be helped...
...Then I guess I'll go wander around for a while too, until it's time.
What about you, Jackal?
I thought I might scout out the venue, so do not mind me.
I see... Later, then.
...This presence... It seems that person is drawing near after all.
This should be another fun job... Heh heh heh...
Hey, monkey trainer... You've got the young lady, and you're still going peeping?
Jeez, you got no shame...
Shut up. I just got dragged here against my will.
Oh, come on! No need to act tough, Shido-han!!
Hey, hey, it's cold, so let's hurry and get in the hot spring~
Alright, let's hit the open-air bath!
Yaaay, an open-air bath~!!
(No, no! Keep it down or they'll catch us peekin'!)
(Sorryyy...)
(Now then, what kind of yukata babes are in the bath~?)
(Wait, this is the men's bath? Ugh, I saw something gross...
...Hm? I hear something...)
...This time we've hired a protector called 'Miroku,' so security is airtight.
(! Miroku...?!)
My, my... But won't he end up learning about that treasure?
Which is why, as soon as this job is over, we'll be disposing of the protector.
To keep him quiet... you see.
My, my... Come to think of it, the cargo's arrival time was moved up, wasn't it?
Shouldn't it be arriving about now?
